svg.text: Vortex atomics — one request, two commit points
SIMT core
VX_decode — opcode 0x2F
funct5 → amo_op (LR, SC, SWAP, ADD, XOR, OR, AND, MIN, MAX)
MINU / MAXU → MIN / MAX + amo_unsigned
funct3 → width: 010 = .W, 011 = .D
routed to the LSU as a load (is_store = 0): every atomic
returns a value to rd
Zacas: funct5 00101 → CAS, rd read as the comparand
aq / rl are captured and carry no behavior
VX_lsu_slice — per-lane sideband
packs amo_req_t into each lane's mem_bus_attr_t:
hart_id {core, warp, thread}
amo_cmp comparand (Zacas only)
amo_unsigned MIN / MAX variant
amo_op amo_op_e
amo_valid attr bit MEM_ATTR_AMO_OFFS
request rw is forced to 0, SC included
rs2 rides the request data word as the operand
width is not carried: the bank counts byteen bits
Memory fabric (per core)
VX_lmem_switch
splits a request's lanes by address class
is_addr_local → local memory banks
everything else → data cache
the attribute field passes through untouched
both subsets may be non-empty in one request
VX_mem_coalescer
merges same-word lanes of plain loads and stores
in_req_no_merge = amo_valid:
an atomic lane is never merged — each lane is its
own read-modify-write
library block sees a generic flag, not an AMO
global lanes
Commit point 1 — shared (local) memory
VX_local_mem bank
single-ported SRAM: an atomic owns its bank for 3 cycles
① read the word ② register it, resolve the reservation
③ VX_amo_alu result written back under the request byteen
VX_amo_unit: min(AMO_RS_SIZE, 4) stations, 3-bit hold credit
a plain store to the word also breaks its reservation
one instance per core: shared memory is visible to one core's warps
Commit point 2 — global memory
cache bank above the LLC — passthrough
VX_cache_amo (IS_LLC = 0)
drops its own copy of the line, forwards the atomic down,
returns the result word without installing a line
present only when L2 or L3 is enabled
last-level cache bank — commit
VX_cache_amo (IS_LLC = 1)
response: the old word, straight from the commit stage
compute stage: VX_amo_alu on the atomic's 8-byte lane
writeback queue → synthetic store through the bank pipe
VX_amo_unit: VX_CFG_AMO_RS_SIZE stations, 6-bit hold credit
any committed store to the line breaks its reservation
every level above it is write-through, so it sees every store
memory request: rw = 0, attr = sideband
Response — the load path
LR, AMO*, CAS return the word as it was before the operation; SC returns 0 on success, 1 on failure, placed in the addressed lane.
The LSU extracts the sub-word by address and sign-extends at the operation width into rd, exactly as for a load.
An atomic takes a load-class response slot in the LSU, so a missing response would hang the warp — every commit point always answers.
A refused or evicted reservation surfaces only as SC = 1, which RISC-V permits for any reason.
old word / SC outcome
to rd
Purple = SIMT core · blue = fabric and cache logic · gold = memory that commits in place · dashed blue = response.
